multiclass_caveat: multi-candidate tau-route (b) uses prediction agreement on a 1139-class label space; the binary-Y advantage recovery (Thm 1A) is heuristic here, so per-condition tau is stored for re-pick. (a) KGA and (c) smooth-drift (max-prob Brier) generalize directly.
eval_pool_note: eval pool is class-balanced then CAPPED at n_eval (1139 classes >> n_eval), so balanced_acc over the sampled singleton-classes equals standard accuracy.
